description: neuralese-direct-v3 (union r2, three phases: full-prompt warm-up 0.5 epoch, program-header direct_sft 1 epoch, whole-trajectory direct_trajectory 1 epoch) on base LFM2.5-350M (LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M, revision 9e6c6ccf; heads from the base model), with neuralese-direct-lfm-v2's declared differences unchanged (line-parity.json): fit-only target_tokens 256, batch_tokens 16384 and the cadence; backbone-inherent backbone lr 7.5e-7 and the measured base gate_pass 26/48.
